crossRefs.note: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth.…

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
translations.bsb: Now Noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came upon the earth.
translations.kjv: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
